title: Encode a message as unary bit groups
summary: Encode the seven-bit ASCII binary representation of text into unary runs.
requirements: Input contains only seven-bit ASCII characters.
For each consecutive run of 1 bits emit 0 followed by as many zeros as bits.
For a run of 0 bits emit 00 followed by as many zeros; separate blocks with one space.
hints: Convert characters to exactly seven bits each.
Compress consecutive equal binary digits into run pairs.
